question.text: An air handling unit (AHU) supply air temperature sensor reads a constant 21.0°C across a 24-hour period, despite outside air temperature swinging from 8°C overnight to 24°C in the afternoon. The AHU's chilled water control valve is modulating normally. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H: Building Control Systems — fault diagnostics

question.text: A zone temperature sensor consistently reads 4°C higher than the setpoint, both during heated occupied hours and during unoccupied hours with heating off. Adjacent zones in the same area read close to their setpoints. The high reading is consistent over weeks. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H: Building Control Systems

question.text: A zone temperature setpoint stepped down from 22.0°C to 21.0°C at 02:00 Monday morning and has held at 21.0°C through the week. Zone temperature now stabilises at 21.0°C with normal modulation of the heating valve. Occupant comfort has not been reported as a problem. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — setpoint scheduling

question.text: An AHU supply air temperature is oscillating ±2°C around an 18°C setpoint with a 5-minute period over a six-hour window. The chilled water valve and damper positions are also oscillating with the same period. Outside conditions are stable. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — PID tuning

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, PID control loop tuning

question.text: Chilled water supply temperature is steady at 7°C with return at 13°C (ΔT = 6 K) during the peak cooling period. Pump flow is constant and matches design. The chiller compressor is loaded at approximately 80%. The ΔT, flow and load have been consistent across the cooling season. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide B2: Heating, ventilating, air conditioning and refrigeration — chilled water design

source.primary: CIBSE Guide B2, chilled water systems

question.text: An office zone CO2 sensor reads a steady 800 ppm across a full 24-hour period, including overnight and weekend hours when the building is verified unoccupied (security records confirm zero occupancy from 18:00 Friday to 07:00 Monday). Adjacent zones show typical CO2 fall to 450-500 ppm during the same unoccupied window. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — CO2 sensor diagnostics

question.text: An outdoor air temperature sensor reads a constant 19°C continuously across a week, while the regional weather service records actual diurnal swings from 5°C overnight to 22°C in the afternoon during the same period. The AHU economiser logic is therefore not engaging during cool-night cooling opportunities. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — outdoor air sensor diagnostics

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, outdoor air sensors

question.text: A VAV box airflow rate is rapidly oscillating between 0.3 m³/s and 0.5 m³/s with a period of approximately 30 seconds throughout the occupied period. Zone temperature remains within 0.3°C of setpoint despite the airflow swings. The damper actuator is in continuous fast motion. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — VAV control tuning

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, VAV control loops

question.text: An office zone temperature sensor reads a constant 23.0°C continuously across three months covering the transition from late winter to early summer. Adjacent zones served by the same AHU show seasonal temperature variation and respond to weather events. The reading has not changed since a building works programme completed at the start of the period. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — sensor failure diagnostics

question.text: An office lighting circuit power draw shows 12.4 kW from 07:00 to 18:30 Monday to Friday, dropping to near-zero overnight and at weekends. Daily energy use is consistent week-on-week. The building is occupied office space. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide F: Energy efficiency in buildings — lighting load profiles

source.primary: CIBSE Guide F, lighting energy profiles

question.text: An AHU supply air temperature persistently overshoots its 18°C cooling setpoint by 3 K during morning startup, then takes 90 minutes to settle. Once settled, the AHU performs as designed. The pattern recurs every weekday after the unoccupied night setback. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — startup overshoot and PID tuning

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, control loop response

question.text: A boiler return water temperature sensor consistently reads 6 K higher than a recently-installed reference probe placed in the same return pipe via a thermowell. The offset is constant across the operating range and has been present since the heating season began. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — calibration drift in immersion sensors

question.text: A pre-school nursery zone temperature setpoint changed from 21°C to 22°C on Monday morning after a parent-committee request. The zone temperature has tracked the new setpoint consistently, with normal valve modulation, since the change. No comfort complaints have been raised. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — setpoint management

question.text: A chilled beam zone shows the heating valve opening for 8 minutes followed by the cooling valve opening for 8 minutes, repeating every 16 minutes for 6 hours despite stable internal gains and a constant zone temperature. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — heating/cooling deadband configuration

question.text: An AHU operates with continuous chilled water valve open at 100% during a winter evening when outdoor air is 4°C and the building is unoccupied. The supply air temperature is 14°C against an 18°C setpoint. The mixing dampers are stuck at 100% outdoor air. Which category best describes the dampers' behaviour?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — actuator failure diagnostics

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, damper actuator faults

question.text: An AHU chilled water valve position is cycling between 15% and 75% open with a period of approximately 90 seconds across the entire occupied period. Supply air temperature is swinging ±1.8 K around the 13°C setpoint at the same frequency. Outside air conditions are stable (22°C, 50% RH) and cooling load is steady. The PI loop was recently retuned by a contractor with aggressive gain settings. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — PI loop tuning and valve hunting

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, control loop tuning

question.text: An AHU supply fan VFD speed steps up from 65% to 80% at 07:00 each weekday morning and steps back down at 19:00. This pattern has been consistent for the past two weeks since the FM team adjusted the occupied-mode duct static pressure setpoint from 250 Pa to 320 Pa to address a downstream zone starvation complaint. Fan power, airflow and static pressure all track the new schedule cleanly with no oscillation. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — supply fan static pressure reset strategies

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, AHU fan control

question.text: An AHU filter differential pressure sensor reads a steady 95 Pa across a full week of operation, including periods when the fan is off overnight. On a healthy installation the reading should drop close to 0 Pa when airflow ceases. A handheld manometer connected to the same tappings reads 0 Pa with fan off and 110 Pa at full flow. The BMS-reported value never deviates from 95 Pa regardless of fan state or filter loading. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — filter DP sensor diagnostics

question.text: An AHU return air temperature sensor reads on average 1.4 K lower than the area-weighted average of the zone temperature sensors served by the AHU. The offset is consistent across a 7-day trend, day and night, at all load conditions. Zone sensors were recently calibrated against a traceable reference and found accurate. The return air sensor was last calibrated 9 years ago and is a thermistor type prone to long-term drift. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — long-term sensor drift and recalibration intervals

question.text: A condenser water loop entering temperature sensor on an air-cooled chiller has been reading 32.0°C continuously for the past 48 hours, including during a period when the chiller was off overnight and ambient temperature dropped to 11°C. The leaving condenser sensor tracks ambient changes normally. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H: Building Control Systems — sensor fault detection

question.text: A gas boiler firing rate trend shows the burner modulating between 30% and 90% with a period of approximately 4 minutes throughout a steady-state mid-load afternoon. Flow temperature swings ±5 K around the 75°C setpoint while return temperature is steady at 60°C and external load (heat meter) is constant. The pattern has persisted for three days since a recent control upgrade. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — boiler sequencing and PID loop tuning

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, boiler control loops

question.text: A primary heating circuit flow temperature setpoint stepped down from 80°C to 70°C at 06:00 on Monday and has remained at the new value throughout the week. The boiler firing rate, return temperature and circulation pump speed all stabilised at correspondingly lower values within 30 minutes. A maintenance log entry notes a weather compensation curve adjustment was made at the weekend. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — weather compensation and setpoint scheduling

question.text: A water-cooled chiller compressor cycles on and off approximately every 8 minutes during a low-load morning period (estimated 15% of design load). Chilled water supply temperature is held within ±1 K of the 6°C setpoint, evaporator flow is stable, and the chiller's internal anti-short-cycle timer is observed to be enforcing minimum off-times. Manufacturer data indicates the unit has no variable-speed compressor and minimum step is 25% capacity. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide B2: Heating, ventilating, air conditioning and refrigeration — chiller part-load behaviour

source.primary: CIBSE Guide B2, chiller cycling at low load

question.text: A primary chilled water flow meter on a variable-primary system reads 3 L/s lower than a portable ultrasonic clamp-on meter installed for verification, across all observed flow rates from 10 to 40 L/s over a 72-hour test. The offset is approximately constant in absolute terms and the percentage error grows at low flow. The BMS meter was last calibrated four years ago. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — flow measurement calibration and drift

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, flow meter calibration

question.text: A fan-coil unit serving a perimeter office zone shows its 2-port chilled water valve cycling between 20% and 80% open every 90 seconds throughout the occupied day. Zone temperature wavers ±0.5°C around the 22°C setpoint while supply air temperature swings between 12°C and 18°C. The valve has been retuned recently with a more aggressive proportional gain. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — PID loop tuning for terminal units

question.text: A zone temperature sensor in a meeting room reports 19.8°C continuously for 48 hours, including periods when the room was confirmed unoccupied with heating off and the corridor at 23°C. A handheld thermometer confirms actual room temperature varied between 18°C and 24°C during the period. The BMS trend shows a perfectly flat line with no diurnal variation. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — zone sensor diagnostics

question.text: A zone temperature sensor in an open-plan office trends 1.8°C higher than three adjacent zone sensors of the same type over a continuous 5-day period, including unoccupied weekend hours when all zones should equalise. The offset is steady regardless of load. The sensor was last calibrated 7 years ago and is mounted on an internal partition away from solar gain or equipment heat sources. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — periodic recalibration of room sensors

question.text: A chilled beam zone shows its heating valve opening to 60% from 06:00 to 08:30, then closing as the cooling valve opens to 50% from 09:00 to 17:00, then heating returning overnight. This pattern repeats consistently across a 5-day trend during mid-season conditions with outdoor temperatures 8–14°C. Zone temperature stays within ±0.4°C of the 22°C setpoint. There is no simultaneous heating and cooling, and a deadband of 2 K is configured between the heating and cooling setpoints. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide B2 — chilled beam sequencing and deadband control

question.text: A CO2 sensor in an open-plan office reads a flat 412 ppm continuously across a 48-hour period covering both occupied (Mon-Tue 08:00-18:00, ~80 people present) and unoccupied periods. Outdoor CO2 is approximately 420 ppm. The demand-controlled ventilation system serving the zone is holding minimum fresh air position throughout. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — CO2 sensor diagnostics for demand-controlled ventilation

question.text: A zone humidity sensor reads 58% RH while a freshly calibrated handheld hygrometer placed adjacent reads 50% RH. Over a 72-hour period the BMS sensor consistently tracks 7-9% RH above the reference across varying conditions (40-65% RH actual). The sensor was installed 4 years ago and has never been recalibrated. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — humidity sensor calibration and drift

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, humidity sensor calibration

question.text: A meeting room CO2 sensor shows a clear diurnal profile over 5 working days: ~430 ppm overnight, rising to 800-1100 ppm during occupied meetings and falling back to background within ~45 minutes of vacancy. The demand-controlled ventilation damper modulates from 20% minimum to 75% open in response, and CO2 never exceeds the 1200 ppm alarm threshold. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide B2 — demand-controlled ventilation performance

question.text: A VOC sensor serving a school classroom DCV control loop has its target setpoint changed by facilities from 300 ppb to 500 ppb on Monday morning, documented in the change log. Across the following 4 days the ventilation damper sits at a lower average position (35% vs prior 55%), VOC readings stabilise around 480 ppb during occupancy, and CO2 remains below 900 ppm. No alarms are active. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — operational setpoint changes in DCV systems

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, IAQ control setpoints

question.text: A CO2-driven fresh air damper in a lecture theatre is observed cycling between 30% and 90% open every 90-120 seconds throughout a 3-hour occupied period. The CO2 sensor reading swings correspondingly between 750 and 1050 ppm in phase with the damper movement. Occupancy is steady at ~150 people and supply fan speed is constant. The PI loop gain was recently increased by a commissioning engineer. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — DCV control loop tuning and hunting

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, control loop tuning

question.text: A gas meter pulse input to the BMS records steady consumption of approximately 120 kWh/h during boiler operation across the previous week. On Monday morning, the recorded gas consumption suddenly steps down by a uniform 10% across all operating hours, while flue gas analysis, boiler firing time, and heat output via the heat meter remain unchanged. The facilities team confirms a new gas supply contract took effect on Monday with a revised calorific value/correction factor entered into the BMS. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE TM39: Building energy metering — gas meter correction factors

question.text: An electricity submeter serving a small power circuit in an open-plan office has logged a constant 4.2 kW reading every half-hour for the past 72 hours, including overnight and weekend periods when the office is unoccupied and other submeters on the same distribution board show their expected diurnal profile. The main incoming meter shows the building's total load varying normally. The submeter's communications status is reported as 'online' by the BMS. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE TM39: Building energy metering — submeter fault detection

question.text: A domestic cold water meter serving a 6-storey office building records zero flow between 08:00 and 18:00 on a normal Wednesday with 250 occupants present. WC flush counters and the booster pump run-hours both indicate normal activity, and the building's drainage flow is consistent with prior weeks. The meter previously registered typical occupied-hour flows of 0.3–0.8 L/s with no recorded change to the metering installation. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide G: Public health and plumbing engineering — water metering

question.text: A heat meter on a district heating connection shows half-hourly energy readings rapidly alternating between roughly 180 kWh and 90 kWh in successive intervals over a 48-hour period. The corresponding flow rate and supply/return temperatures appear stable on trends, but the substation control valve is observed cycling fully open then nearly closed every 20–25 minutes. Building heating demand has been steady with mild outdoor conditions. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H: Building Control Systems — control valve tuning and hunting

question.text: Half-hourly electricity import data from the main building meter for a typical occupied weekday shows a smooth ramp-up from 45 kW at 06:00 to a plateau of approximately 180 kW between 09:00 and 17:00, then a decline to 50 kW by 19:00. Weekend profiles show a flat 40–50 kW baseload. The pattern has been consistent across the past four weeks, matches the building's metered load benchmark in CIBSE TM46, and the energy manager confirms no equipment or schedule changes. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE TM46: Energy benchmarks — half-hourly electricity profiles

question.text: A data centre CRAC unit return air temperature has been logged at 18°C for 72 hours, with the chilled water valve fully open and the compressor running continuously. The cold aisle temperature measured by a portable reference is 24°C and IT load has been steady. The CRAC setpoint is 22°C. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — sensor calibration and data centre cooling control

source.review_notes: All 3 reviewers (Claude/GPT-5/Gemini) reasoned that a sensor reading completely static at 18°C for 72 hours while system runs at max capacity is a stuck/failed sensor (A), not calibration drift (B). Drift would still show variation with load.

question.text: A commercial kitchen extract fan trend shows continuous operation at 100% speed for 168 hours, including overnight periods when the kitchen is unoccupied and gas interlocks are closed. Review of the BMS schedule shows the time clock was overridden to 'permanent on' by a maintenance engineer two weeks ago following an interlock fault. The override has not been reset. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide F: Energy efficiency in buildings — kitchen ventilation scheduling

question.text: A laboratory fume cupboard face velocity sensor reads exactly 0.50 m/s for 48 consecutive hours, despite sash position varying from fully closed to fully open during the working day and the VAV extract damper modulating across its full range. A handheld anemometer at the sash shows actual face velocity varying between 0.3 and 0.8 m/s. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — laboratory ventilation sensor diagnostics; BS EN 14175

question.text: A swimming pool plantroom AHU is maintaining hall air at 30°C and 60% RH, with pool water at 29°C. The dewpoint sensor reads 21.5°C and the dehumidification control is satisfied. Trends over 5 days show stable conditions, no condensation reported on glazing, and fresh air damper modulating between minimum and 40% as expected. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide G: Public health and plumbing engineering — swimming pool environment control

question.text: A laboratory room pressure sensor reading oscillates between -15 Pa and +5 Pa with a period of approximately 20 seconds throughout a 24-hour observation, while supply and extract VAV dampers are visibly cycling in opposition at the same frequency. Room differential pressure setpoint is -10 Pa. No fume cupboard sash movements correlate with the swings, and the oscillation persists overnight when the lab is unoccupied. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — laboratory pressure control loop tuning

question.text: An office AHU supply air temperature setpoint trend shows a step change from 14°C to 16°C at 06:00 on Monday, with the chilled water valve immediately reducing opening from 65% to 40%. Supply air temperature tracks the new setpoint within 5 minutes and remains stable for the rest of the day. The facilities team confirmed a seasonal reset schedule was activated. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — supply air temperature reset strategies

question.text: During a four-day August heatwave with outdoor temperatures peaking at 34°C, a London office's chilled water plant runs continuously at full load, with space temperatures drifting to 25°C in west-facing zones by 16:00 each day. Chilled water supply holds at 6°C, valves are at 100% open, and AHU supply air is at design 13°C. The system reverts to normal control margins as outdoor temperature drops to 22°C the following week. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide A — design summer year and overheating during extreme weather

source.primary: CIBSE Guide A, thermal comfort under extreme weather

question.text: A return air CO₂ sensor in a school classroom reads 480 ppm at 08:00 on Monday and slowly climbs to 520 ppm by 17:00, even though the room is unoccupied during the half-term holiday week and outdoor CO₂ is approximately 420 ppm. Over the past six months, the morning baseline reading has gradually risen from 410 ppm to 480 ppm. The damper and fan controls behave normally. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE TM57 — CO₂ sensor calibration drift and recalibration intervals

source.primary: CIBSE TM57, indoor air quality monitoring

question.text: A heating circuit flow temperature sensor on a commercial LTHW system reads 70.0°C continuously for 48 hours over the Christmas holiday shutdown period. The boiler is off, the circulating pump is off, and outdoor temperature is -2°C. A handheld probe on the same pipe reads 8°C. When the boiler restarts after the holiday, the BMS sensor still reads 70.0°C while other circuit sensors show rising temperatures. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — sensor fault diagnosis and stuck reading identification

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, BMS fault diagnostics

question.text: Following replacement of a heating coil control valve actuator, the AHU supply air temperature swings between 18°C and 24°C with a period of approximately 4 minutes throughout the occupied day. The valve position trend shows continuous reversals between 20% and 80%, and the return air temperature also oscillates with a 2°C amplitude. The setpoint has been unchanged at 21°C for three weeks. Which category best describes this observation?

answer.citation: CIBSE Guide H — PID loop tuning following actuator replacement

source.primary: CIBSE Guide H, control loop tuning
